map.预处理把 SQL 结构与数据分开发给数据库，数据不会被当作代码解析，从根本上避免: Prepared statements send the SQL structure and the data to the database separately, so the data is never parsed as code — eliminating SQL injection at the root; reusing the same statement also reuses its execution plan. Note that prepared statements do not cover every case: identifiers such as table and column names cannot be parameterized and must be validated against an allowlist.
